job.title: NSM - Civil and Infrastructure
job.description:
The opportunity

A well-established Australian manufacturer of infrastructure products is looking for a Head of Civil Infrastructure to lead its national sales team. You’ll own the civil portfolio, lead a team of BDMs selling direct to market across the eastern states, and set the direction for how the business wins Tier 1 & 2 projects in water, roads, subdivisions, tunnels, data centres and electrification.
This is a leadership role, not a sales role with a title. The business wants someone to take ownership, build a stronger hunting culture, and turn a healthy pipeline into consistent, profitable growth.

About the business

Our client is a respected manufacturer supplying utilities, councils, contractors and developers nationally. Its products are on major infrastructure projects across Australia, and it’s investing to grow its position in civil and emerging markets.

What you’ll be doing

  • Leading, coaching and developing a national team of BDMs, building a sharper focus on new business
  • Owning the national civil strategy, budget and forecast
  • Driving pipeline discipline: qualification, coverage and a long-range view of major projects
  • Building account strategies with Tier 1 contractors, utilities and asset owners
  • Stepping in on strategic projects at executive level
  • Working closely with manufacturing, project delivery, specification and distribution teams
  • Growing emerging segments including data centres, electrification and renewables

What we’re looking for

  • Senior sales leadership in civil infrastructure products or services (pipe, precast, drainage, geosynthetics, valves, civil materials or Tier 1 contracting)
  • A track record of leading teams and driving growth through new business, not just managing existing accounts
  • Strong commercial judgement: you understand margin, forecasting and which projects are worth chasing
  • Established relationships with Tier 1 & 2 contractors, utilities or asset owners
  • A direct, considered leadership style, and the polish to work with senior stakeholders
  • Based in Melbourne or Sydney, with interstate travel

What’s in it for you

  • A competitive base salary plus super, vehicle and STI
  • Real ownership of a national portfolio, with a GM who backs his leaders
  • Clear progression and long-term career opportunities
  • A large, growing market with major infrastructure, data centre and energy projects ahead

Next steps
Apply now with your CV, or call Olly Kemp at SearchWorks for a confidential conversation. All enquiries are treated in strict confidence.

job.title: Business Development Manager - Renewables
job.description:
Our client is a global manufacturer of BESS, hybrid power, and solar systems — and they're building out their Australian renewables division. This is the hire that kicks it off.
The opportunity
This is a national BDM role focused on battery energy storage systems (BESS), hybrid power, and solar — selling into the solar distributor and installer channel across Australia. The product range spans 12kW residential through to 3,250kW industrial, with deal values from $50k up to $1M+. You'll be the first dedicated resource in this division, which means genuine autonomy and the ability to shape the market strategy from the ground up.
About the company
A global manufacturer with a strong footprint in power generation — generators, BESS, hybrid systems, solar, and lighting towers. They're a real manufacturer, not a rebadger, and their hybrid solar/diesel/battery capability is a genuine point of difference in the market. The Australian renewables team is growing and this role is central to that growth.
What you'll be doing

  • Building relationships with solar distributors, installers, EPC contractors and consultants nationally
  • Identifying and converting new business opportunities across commercial, industrial and infrastructure sectors
  • Providing technical guidance and pre-sales support on BESS and hybrid configurations
  • Managing your own pipeline via CRM — site visits, meetings, project tracking
  • Contributing to new product launches into the Australian market
  • Regular national travel (2-3 nights per month)

What we're looking for

  • Proven B2B sales track record in commercial solar, battery storage, electrical or power generation
  • Solid understanding of the solar distributor/installer channel — how they buy and what they care about
  • Comfortable with technical product conversations — you don't need an engineering degree, but you need to know your specs
  • Self-directed and comfortable building from scratch — this isn't a warm patch handover (new role)
  • Based in Sydney; willing to travel nationally (2-3 nights/month)

What's in it for you

  • $120k base + super + fully maintained vehicle
  • Uncapped commission — OTE circa $200k for a performer
  • National role with genuine autonomy
  • Be the person who builds this brand's renewables presence in Australia
  • A product range that covers residential through to heavy industrial — you're not limited to one segment

job.title: Business Development Manager - Premium Stone
job.description:
The opportunity
Most building products jobs want 10 years in the industry before they’ll talk to you. This one doesn’t. If you can win new business, build real relationships and follow a deal through to the end, we can teach you the product. You’d be representing beautiful, high-end natural stone, porcelain and engineered timber flooring. It’s an easy product to be proud of when you’re sitting with an architect or builder.

About the company
Our client is a long-established, family-built supplier of premium surfaces with more than 50 years in the market and national turnover of around $80–90 million. They’ve been growing steadily in Queensland and have just opened a brand-new showroom.
The business is stable and well-resourced, and it backs its people.

What you’ll be doing

  • Winning new business across the Gold Coast. This is mostly a hunting role.
  • Building relationships with architects and interior designers, builders and subcontractors
  • Getting products specified on projects, then protecting that spec through to delivery
  • Working with estimators, contract administrators and developer design teams to keep projects on track
  • Managing a 50/50 mix of commercial and residential work, with projects from about $20k up to $500k

What we’re looking for

  • A proven B2B sales track record in any industry. Building products, interiors, A&D, construction, hospitality supply, industrial and B2B services backgrounds all work.
  • A genuine liking for new business: making the first call, getting in the door and staying the course
  • Someone who’s curious, coachable and confident in front of creative and technical people
  • An eye for design or an interest in it is a real plus
  • Existing relationships with architects and designers, or experience specifying any interior product, will put you ahead (not essential)
  • You must live on the Gold Coast or in South Brisbane

What’s in it for you

  • $100,000–$110,000 base + super
  • $18,000 car allowance
  • Uncapped commission, with $20–30k realistic on top in your first year and plenty of room to grow from there
  • A premium product range that’s easy to back
  • A new showroom to host clients in
  • A stable employer that has kept people in this role long term (the current benchmark is 4 years)
  • Real ownership of your territory
